title: MapAlign: Feature-Based Georeferencing of Historical Survey of India Maps: A Reproducible Baseline Comparison
description: A reproducible benchmark that georeferences a 1926 Survey of India sheet (57 D/11, Mysore) to OpenStreetMap with LoFTR, SIFT, sparse learned matchers (DISK/ALIKED + LightGlue) and manual control points, all scored in metres on locked held-out control points, plus a blind, timed human re-pick of every control point. Includes the exact inputs, the frozen configuration, every result, a research paper and the scripts that regenerate it.
